q1.question: Where do positive V4 setup events occur across EXIT lifecycle phases?
q1.interpretation: Most setup activity is pre_seen in winners and no-legal losses, but setup is not exclusively pre_seen. Winners contain 7 seen_unplaced and 4 post_placed positive-setup events; the three WaterSpaceV3-only seeds contain 25 post_placed setup events. Therefore a pre_seen-only gate would remove behavior that exists in both upside and downside trajectories.

q2.question: Do V4-only winners materially depend on setup reward after EXIT has first been seen?
q2.interpretation: Yes, materially for the proposed strict pre_seen-only gate: 5/11 canonical V4-only winners have at least one post-sighting decision for which removing the setup contribution removes the historically chosen move from the local best set. Four winners are sensitive while EXIT is seen-but-unplaced and two have post-placement sensitivity (seed 2005 appears in both). A pre_seen-only gate therefore fails the required winner-preservation condition.

q3.question: Are compact no-legal-move near-wins driven by setup-sensitive choices during seen_unplaced, especially around EXIT deferral/refresh?
q3.interpretation: Only a minority of canonical no-legal failures are locally setup-gate-sensitive after EXIT sighting: 8/39 overall and 5/28 near-wins. In seen_unplaced, all 12 gate-sensitive decisions across the 39 failures are legal-EXIT deferrals, and 10 are branching; among the 28 near-wins there are 10 sensitive deferrals. However these trajectories contain 157 seen_unplaced refreshes (136 among near-wins) and 24 visible-to-not-visible transitions (21 among near-wins), while most failures have no post-sighting gate-sensitive choice at all. Thus setup reward explains a concrete subset of EXIT-deferral decisions but does not drive the dominant no-legal/refresh failure mode.

q4.question: Is post-EXIT runaway growth on 2067, 2241, 2272 actually caused by setup-sensitive decisions?

seed_2067.interpretation: V4 has 9 post-sighting gate-sensitive decisions (8 post-placement), so setup bonus has real local causal reach. But harmful growth also continues after frontier >10 and includes setup-zero branching, so the pre_seen-only gate cannot be said to directly explain or solve the entire failure.

seed_2241.interpretation: There are zero post-sighting gate-sensitive decisions. V4 performs 17 setup-zero post-placement branches versus 2 setup-positive, with 26 of 28 units of post-placement branch growth setup-zero; 17 units of growth occur after first exceeding 10. The proposed gate has no local decision-level reach over this canonical failure.

seed_2272.interpretation: There is exactly one post-placement gate-sensitive decision (turn 27, before first frontier >10 at turn 30). Thereafter most runaway growth is setup-zero: 16 setup-zero post-placement branches contribute 24 growth versus 3 setup-positive branches contributing 5; 20 growth occurs after first exceeding 10. The gate could alter one early branch but not the dominant observed runaway topology.

q4.group_interpretation: Post-EXIT failure is not generally caused by the bounded setup reward. Across the three seeds, only 25% of post-placement branching events and 25.6% of post-placement open growth are setup-positive; setup-zero branches account for 42/56 branches and 61/82 growth. Seed 2241 is entirely gate-insensitive after sighting. Therefore failure-reach for a pre_seen-only gate is incomplete.

q5.question: Is the single pre_seen-only setup gate supported for a later bounded V5 implementation test?
evidence: 5/11 canonical V4-only winners have post-sighting gate-sensitive decisions; removing setup reward after first sighting would directly change their historical local best choice.
Only 8/39 V4 no-legal losses have any post-sighting gate-sensitive decision, so most compact/refresh dead ends are not locally attributable to setup bonus.
Seed 2241 has zero post-sighting gate-sensitive decisions despite the canonical V4 failure.
Seed 2272 has one early post-placement sensitive decision, but most later growth occurs after frontier >10 or on setup-zero branches.
Seed 2067 has substantial setup sensitivity, but also setup-zero growth after frontier >10, so even this failure is only partially within gate reach.
q5.interpretation: The phase-localized local-score evidence rejects the proposed pre_seen-only gate as the single next V5 mechanism. It would remove decisions that matter to 5/11 canonical V4-only winners while still lacking direct local reach over large parts of both observed downside modes. No claim is made about counterfactual win rate because no modified policy was executed.

event_semantics.best_set_changed: actual maximum-score move set differs from the hypothetical maximum-score move set
event_semantics.gate_sensitive: historical chosen move is absent from the hypothetical maximum-score set after removing only bounded setup contribution for that decision

lifecycle_phase_definitions.placement_move_rule: EXIT placement itself is classified by its pre-action state, normally seen_unplaced/currently_visible
lifecycle_phase_definitions.pre_seen: EXIT has never entered the hand
lifecycle_phase_definitions.seen_unplaced: EXIT has entered the hand at least once and has not been placed; substate tracks current visibility

recommended_next_step: Perform one bounded, non-mutating local score-component margin audit on the same canonical trajectories for legal-EXIT deferrals in the 28 no-legal near-wins: at each deferral compare the historically chosen move against the best legal EXIT move and decompose their score margin into delta-open, water, trapped-water, EXIT-placement, equipment-collection, and bounded-setup components. This targets the large majority of EXIT/refresh near-wins that are not setup-gate-sensitive, without implementing V5 or consuming fresh seeds.
overall_interpretation: The 400-seed instrumentation integrity gate passed exactly, so all phase and local-score audit results describe the canonical Worker #4 V4 trajectories.
Positive setup is concentrated pre_seen but persists after EXIT sighting in both winning and losing trajectories.
The strict pre_seen-only gate fails winner preservation because 5/11 V4-only winners have post-sighting gate-sensitive decisions.

The gate also fails failure reach: most no-legal losses are not setup-sensitive after sighting, and post-EXIT runaway growth on WaterSpaceV3-only seeds is mostly setup-zero; seed 2241 is fully gate-insensitive after sighting.
Therefore the proposed pre_seen-only bounded-merge setup gate is not supported for the next V5 implementation test.
